entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned AC to GA-10 for the State.
2. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State seeks four weeks' time for filing counter-affidavit.
3. Separate counter-affidavit shall be filed by the District Magistrate, Munger and the District Land Acquisition Officer, Munger duly sworn by them.
The counter-affidavit shall give parawise reply of the pleadings made in the writ application and in the supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the petitioners.

4. At this stage, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that supplementary affidavit has been filed on 02.05.2025, but inadvertently, before supplementary affidavit, the word 'reply to' has been prefixed Patna High Court CWJC No.5821 of 2025(3)
dt.06-05-2025 and thus, seeks permission to rectify the same.

6. The counter-affidavit shall clearly record that as to whether the petitioners are entitled for compensation of the land along with the structure or not if not, why, if yes, then why compensation till date has not been given to the petitioners when notification under Section 3(d) of the National Suresh Prasad Sah vs The State Of Bihar on 6 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79464800/
